newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Soccer - Poles, police clash before Czech friendly.
newsitem.headline: Soccer - Poles, police clash before Czech friendly.

text.p: Two Czech city policemen were injured on Wednesday in a clash with Polish fans before a friendly soccer international in the northern Czech city of Ostrava, the Czech CTK news agency said.
An Ostrava city policemen told CTK that one of the officers had some teeth knocked out when he was hit with a bar during a scuffle with up to 70 or 80 fans in a central city square.
Police said some hundreds of Polish fans arrived en masse in the afternoon by train in the large Czech industrial city near the Polish border.
The Czech Republic won the international friendly 2-1.
